en.headline: US fintech Clear Street completes acquisition of Boom Securities for Hong Kong presence
en.dek: InvestHK said the New York firm has established its first licensed base in the city after acquiring the 1997-founded online brokerage, which holds SFC licences for 18 markets.
body: Invest Hong Kong announced today that New York-headquartered Clear Street has completed its acquisition of Boom Securities (H.K.) Limited and established its first licensed presence in Hong Kong.

Founded in Hong Kong in 1997, Boom Securities is an online brokerage holding Securities and Futures Commission Type 1, Type 2 and Type 7 licences and providing access to 18 global markets. It now operates under the brand Boom Securities powered by Clear Street.

The transaction, first announced in February this year, received all required regulatory approvals including clearance from the SFC. Hong Kong will serve as a strategic hub for Clear Street’s Asia-Pacific expansion and the deployment of its cloud-native capital markets platform.

Associate Director-General of Investment Promotion King Leung said the investment introduces modern technology that enhances market access for investors while reinforcing Hong Kong’s position as an international financial centre.

zh.headline: 美國金融科技Clear Street完成收購寶盛證券 設香港首個持牌據點
zh.dek: 投資推廣署宣布，紐約公司在取得證監會批准後，完成收購一九九七年成立的網上經紀行，為客戶提供十八個環球市場渠道。
body: 投資推廣署今日宣布，總部位於紐約的雲端原生金融基建科技公司Clear Street已完成收購寶盛證券（香港）有限公司，正式在香港設立首個持牌業務據點。
寶盛證券於一九九七年在香港成立，持有證監會第一類、第二類及第七類牌照，為客戶提供十八個環球市場的投資渠道。現時以Clear Street旗下寶盛證券品牌營運。
有關交易早於今年二月公布，已取得包括證監會在內的所有所需監管批准。香港將成為Clear Street拓展亞太區業務及部署其雲端原生平台的策略樞紐。
投資推廣署助理署長梁瀚璟表示，是次投資引入現代化技術，為投資者優化市場連接，同時鞏固香港作為國際金融中心的地位。
